# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting is read from an environment variable named `AEGIS_<NAME>` (upper case), or from a
`.env` file in development. Secrets are typed as `SecretStr`: they never appear in logs, `repr()` or
validation errors. With `AEGIS_ENV=production` the process refuses to start with unsafe values
(SQLite, no Redis, embedded vector index, wildcard hosts/CORS, development mailbox, no metrics
token, HSTS off, DEBUG or non-JSON logging, optional staff two-factor authentication, the
simulated payment provider, placeholder secrets).

An empty variable (`AEGIS_METRICS_TOKEN=`) means *unset* - the default applies - so an empty value can
never become a valid credential. In production, secrets can also be mounted as files: set
`AEGIS_SECRETS_DIR` to a directory holding one file per variable (`AEGIS_JWT_SECRET`,
`AEGIS_DATABASE_URL`, ...); environment variables take precedence over `.env`, which takes
precedence over secret files.

Additional variables read outside the settings model: `AEGIS_SECRETS_DIR` (see above),
`AEGIS_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL` (schema-owner connection used by migrations), `AEGIS_DB_APP_ROLE`
(runtime role granted by migration 0002), `AEGIS_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` (non-interactive
`aegis create-admin`), `AEGIS_TEST_DATABASE_URL` (run the test suite on PostgreSQL). The Docker
Compose file additionally reads `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `AEGIS_DB_OWNER_PASSWORD`,
`AEGIS_DB_APP_PASSWORD`, `REDIS_PASSWORD` and `QDRANT_API_KEY` (created by `aegis init-env --docker`).

## Application

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_ENV` | Deployment environment; `production` enforces the safety rules listed above. | development | `development` / `test` / `staging` / `production` |
| `AEGIS_APP_NAME` | Application name shown in the OpenAPI document. | AegisSupport AI | - |
| `AEGIS_LOG_LEVEL` | Minimum log level (`DEBUG` is refused in production). | INFO | `DEBUG` / `INFO` / `WARNING` / `ERROR` |
| `AEGIS_LOG_JSON` | One JSON object per log line (for log shippers; required in production); `false` prints readable lines. | True | - |
| `AEGIS_API_DOCS_ENABLED` | Serve `/docs` and `/openapi.json`; unset means everywhere except production. | (unset) | - |
| `AEGIS_COMPANY_NAME` | Company name used in the assistant's prompt and in e-mails. | Acme Home Electronics | - |
| `AEGIS_HELP_CENTER_URL` | Help-centre URL the assistant is told to link to (the guard enforces the link allow-list). | https://help.acme.example | - |

## HTTP server

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | Accepted `Host` header values (other hosts get 400); explicit names in production. | localhost, 127.0.0.1, testserver | comma-separated list |
| `AEGIS_CORS_ORIGINS` | Browser origins allowed by CORS; empty disables CORS. HTTPS-only, no `*`, in production. | (empty) | comma-separated list |
| `AEGIS_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | Proxy addresses/networks whose `X-Forwarded-For` is trusted for the client IP. | (empty) | comma-separated list |
| `AEGIS_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES` | Largest accepted request body (JSON endpoints); larger bodies get 413. | 65536 | >= 1024, <= 10485760 |
| `AEGIS_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | Largest accepted knowledge-base upload. | 1048576 | >= 1024, <= 10485760 |
| `AEGIS_HSTS_ENABLED` | Send `Strict-Transport-Security`; required in production (serve behind TLS). | False | - |

## Database

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_DATABASE_URL` | Async SQLAlchemy URL: `postgresql+asyncpg://` in production, SQLite for development only. | (secret) | secret |
| `AEGIS_DATABASE_POOL_SIZE` | Connections kept open per process (PostgreSQL). | 10 | >= 1, <= 100 |
| `AEGIS_DATABASE_MAX_OVERFLOW` | Extra connections allowed during bursts (PostgreSQL). | 10 | >= 0, <= 100 |
| `AEGIS_DATABASE_POOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | How long a request waits for a free connection before failing. | 10.0 | > 0, <= 120 |
| `AEGIS_DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS` | PostgreSQL `statement_timeout` for application sessions. | 15000 | >= 100, <= 600000 |
| `AEGIS_DATABASE_ECHO` | Log every SQL statement; refused in production (parameters contain customer data). | False | - |

## Redis

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_REDIS_URL` | Redis for rate limits, locks, caches and idempotency; unset means in-process (single process only). | (unset) | secret |
| `AEGIS_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX` | Prefix of every key; the Redis ACL in docker-compose.yml confines the app to it. | aegis | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,31}$` |
| `AEGIS_REDIS_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Socket timeout for Redis commands. | 2.0 | > 0, <= 30 |

## Authentication and cryptography

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_JWT_SECRET` | HMAC key for access tokens (HS256): at least 32 random characters. | **required** | secret |
| `AEGIS_JWT_ISSUER` | `iss` claim written into and required from access tokens. | aegis-support | - |
| `AEGIS_JWT_AUDIENCE` | `aud` claim written into and required from access tokens. | aegis-support-api | - |
| `AEGIS_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | Access-token lifetime. | 900 | >= 60, <= 3600 |
| `AEGIS_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | Refresh-token lifetime; refresh tokens rotate on every use. | 1209600 | >= 3600, <= 7776000 |
| `AEGIS_SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | Absolute session lifetime; refreshing cannot extend a session past it. | 2592000 | >= 3600, <= 15552000 |
| `AEGIS_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS` | Comma-separated Fernet keys for encrypted columns; the first encrypts, the rest only decrypt. | **required** | secret |
| `AEGIS_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` | Minimum password length (common and account-derived passwords are refused too). | 12 | >= 8, <= 64 |
| `AEGIS_LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS` | Failed logins before the account is locked temporarily. | 5 | >= 3, <= 20 |
| `AEGIS_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS` | Lockout duration after too many failed logins. | 900 | >= 60, <= 86400 |
| `AEGIS_PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_SECONDS` | Lifetime of a single-use password-reset token. | 1800 | >= 300, <= 86400 |
| `AEGIS_PASSWORD_RESET_URL` | Front-end page that receives the reset token (in the URL fragment). | https://support.acme.example/reset-password | - |
| `AEGIS_ARGON2_TIME_COST` | Argon2id iterations per password hash. | 3 | >= 1, <= 10 |
| `AEGIS_ARGON2_MEMORY_COST_KIB` | Argon2id memory per password hash, in KiB. | 65536 | >= 1024, <= 1048576 |
| `AEGIS_ARGON2_PARALLELISM` | Argon2id lanes per password hash. | 4 | >= 1, <= 16 |
| `AEGIS_METRICS_TOKEN` | Bearer token for `/metrics` (16+ characters); required in production when metrics are on. | (unset) | secret |
| `AEGIS_MFA_REQUIRED_FOR_STAFF` | Staff must use two-factor authentication; until they enrol they can only manage their own sign-in (required in production). | False | - |
| `AEGIS_MFA_CHALLENGE_TTL_SECONDS` | How long the second login step (the code prompt) stays valid after a correct password. | 300 | >= 60, <= 900 |

## Rate limits

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_RL_LOGIN_PER_IP_PER_MINUTE` | Login attempts per client IP per minute. | 20 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_LOGIN_PER_ACCOUNT_PER_15_MINUTES` | Login attempts per account (e-mail) per 15 minutes. | 10 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_PASSWORD_RESET_PER_HOUR` | Password-reset requests per client IP, and per e-mail address, per hour. | 5 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_REFRESH_PER_MINUTE` | Token refreshes per client IP per minute. | 30 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_API_PER_USER_PER_MINUTE` | Authenticated API requests per user per minute. | 120 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_API_PER_IP_PER_MINUTE` | API requests per client IP per minute. | 300 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_LLM_PER_USER_PER_MINUTE` | Messages to the assistant per user per minute. | 10 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_LLM_PER_USER_PER_DAY` | Messages to the assistant per user per day. | 300 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_UPLOAD_PER_HOUR` | Knowledge-base uploads per administrator per hour. | 20 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_ADMIN_PER_MINUTE` | Administrative API requests per user per minute. | 60 | >= 1 |
| `AEGIS_RL_PRIVACY_EXPORT_PER_DAY` | Personal-data exports per user per day. | 5 | >= 1 |

## Language model

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_LLM_PROVIDER` | `offline` (deterministic, grounded, no network) or `anthropic` (Claude). | offline | `offline` / `anthropic` |
| `AEGIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Claude API key; required when the provider is `anthropic`. | (unset) | secret |
| `AEGIS_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` | Alternative Claude API endpoint (HTTPS only), for example a company gateway. | (unset) | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_AGENT_MODEL` | Model that writes replies and calls tools. | claude-opus-5-5 | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_CLASSIFIER_MODEL` | Model that classifies intent, priority and sentiment (structured output). | claude-haiku-4-5 | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_SUMMARY_MODEL` | Model that summarises long conversations. | claude-haiku-4-5 | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_AGENT_EFFORT` | Effort level of the agent model (`output_config.effort`). | low | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `AEGIS_LLM_AGENT_MAX_TOKENS` | Output-token cap per agent call. | 4096 | >= 512, <= 32000 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_CLASSIFIER_MAX_TOKENS` | Output-token cap per classification call. | 1024 | >= 256, <= 4096 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS` | Output-token cap per summary call. | 1024 | >= 256, <= 4096 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Timeout per model request. | 45.0 | > 0, <= 300 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_MAX_RETRIES` | SDK retries for transient failures (429, 5xx, connection errors) with backoff. | 2 | >= 0, <= 5 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_REFUSAL_FALLBACK_ENABLED` | Let the API retry a refused request on a fallback model (server-side fallback). | True | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_FALLBACK_TO_OFFLINE` | Answer with the offline model when Claude is unavailable, over budget or circuit-broken. | True | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_PROMPT_CACHING` | Cache the stable prompt prefix (system prompt and tool definitions). | True | - |
| `AEGIS_LLM_CIRCUIT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD` | Consecutive provider failures that open the circuit breaker. | 5 | >= 1, <= 100 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_CIRCUIT_RESET_SECONDS` | How long the circuit stays open before a trial request. | 30.0 | > 0, <= 3600 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_USER_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET` | Tokens (input + output) one user may consume per day. | 200000 | >= 1000 |
| `AEGIS_LLM_GLOBAL_DAILY_COST_LIMIT_USD` | Estimated model spend allowed per day across all users, in USD. | 25.0 | > 0 |

## Agent

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS` | Model calls per customer turn (bounds the tool loop). | 4 | >= 1, <= 10 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS` | Tool executions per customer turn. | 6 | >= 1, <= 20 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Wall-clock limit for one customer turn. | 60.0 | > 0, <= 300 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Timeout per tool execution. | 5.0 | > 0, <= 60 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_MIN_CONFIDENCE` | Classification confidence below which the assistant asks a clarifying question. | 0.55 | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_HISTORY_MESSAGES` | Recent messages sent to the model verbatim (older ones are summarised). | 8 | >= 0, <= 40 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_SUMMARY_TRIGGER_MESSAGES` | Conversation length that triggers a rolling summary. | 14 | >= 4, <= 200 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS` | Longest accepted customer message. | 4000 | >= 200, <= 20000 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS` | Longest reply the assistant may send (longer replies are truncated). | 2500 | >= 200, <= 20000 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_SUSPICIOUS_ESCALATION_THRESHOLD` | Manipulation attempts in one conversation before a human takes over. | 3 | >= 1, <= 50 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_FAILURE_ESCALATION_THRESHOLD` | Failed answers in one conversation before a human takes over. | 2 | >= 1, <= 20 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_ALLOWED_LINK_DOMAINS` | Domains the assistant may link to; any other link is removed from replies. | help.acme.example, support.acme.example | comma-separated list |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_ACTION_TTL_SECONDS` | How long a proposed action waits for the customer's confirmation. | 900 | >= 60, <= 86400 |
| `AEGIS_AGENT_MAX_TICKETS_PER_DAY` | Support tickets the assistant may open per customer per day. | 5 | >= 1, <= 100 |

## Retrieval (RAG)

| Variable | Meaning | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AEGIS_QDRANT_URL` | Qdrant server URL; required in production. | (unset) | - |
| `AEGIS_QDRANT_API_KEY` | Qdrant API key. | (unset) | secret |
| `AEGIS_QDRANT_LOCATION` | Embedded Qdrant when no URL is set: `:memory:` or a directory (development). | :memory: | - |
| `AEGIS_QDRANT_COLLECTION` | Collection that holds the knowledge-base chunks. | aegis_knowledge | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,62}$` |
| `AEGIS_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` | `hashing` (local, deterministic, no network) or `voyage` (Voyage AI). | hashing | `hashing` / `voyage` |
| `AEGIS_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS` | Vector size; must match the collection (re-index after changing it). | 512 | >= 64, <= 4096 |
| `AEGIS_VOYAGE_API_KEY` | Voyage AI API key; required when the provider is `voyage`. | (unset) | secret |
| `AEGIS_VOYAGE_MODEL` | Voyage AI embedding model. | voyage-3.5 | - |
| `AEGIS_VOYAGE_BASE_URL` | Voyage AI endpoint (HTTPS only; the only host the embedder may call). | https://api.voyageai.com | - |
| `AEGIS_RAG_TOP_K` | Chunks placed into the model's context per turn. | 5 | >= 1, <= 20 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_CANDIDATE_K` | Candidates fetched from the index before filtering and ranking. | 15 | >= 1, <= 100 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_SCORE_THRESHOLD` | Minimum similarity for a chunk to be used. | 0.2 | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS` | Character budget for retrieved context per turn. | 6000 | >= 500, <= 50000 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_MAX_CHUNKS_PER_DOCUMENT` | Chunks a single document may contribute to one answer. | 2 | >= 1, <= 10 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_CHUNK_CHARS` | Target chunk size when indexing. | 1000 | >= 200, <= 8000 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_CHUNK_OVERLAP_CHARS` | Overlap between consecutive chunks. | 150 | >= 0, <= 2000 |
| `AEGIS_RAG_MAX_CHUNKS_PER_UPLOAD` | Chunks one upload may produce; larger documents are rejected. | 400 | >= 1, <= 5000 |
